title: sorghum riedelii
intro: Sorghum riedelii, commonly known as the "Prairie Sage" or "Desert Sage", is a type of flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Sorghum riedelii include its use as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it beneficial for treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Sorghum riedelii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
